metadata.methods_description: EEG data were recorded from participants seated in a darkened sound-isolating booth listening to continuous audiobook stimuli (peaky speech) presented at 65 dB SPL and 48 kHz sampling rate through ER-2 insert earphones connected to an RME Digiface USB sound card. Custom Python scripts using expyfun controlled stimulus presentation. Raw EEG was recorded in Brain Products BrainVision format (.eeg, .vhdr, .vmrk), with stimulus and regressor files stored in .hdf5 format for deconvolution analyses.
